description: (Tag:fighter)(Tag:humanoid)(Tag:infernal)(Tag:medium-size)(Tag:tactician)(Character)Albedo was a Nazarick Floor Guardian, a succubus dark knight and true tank who can destroy fortress walls in one blow and resist anything that cannot level a street thanks to many defensive abilities.
